top_episode.logline: At the reading of Savitri's will, Nandini makes her final move, and Rhea must choose between her mother and the truth.
continuity_notes: The confirmed DNA report (blue folder) is in the lawyer's hands.
Rhea wears no engagement ring from this episode onward.
Savitri is in a wheelchair after collapsing off-screen.

top_promos.title: Evidence twist — Rhea

lines.text: I know you used Dadi's signature stamp. I know you chained the door the night of the fire.
Gasps. Vikram steps in front of Maya without thinking.
And I have it on tape. Your voice. Telling me he was "a contract."
Rhea plays the recording. Nandini's voice fills the library.
You'd destroy your own mother for her? For a waitress?
No. For the sister you made me hate.

top_promos.title: Return from the dead

lines.text: Police cars line the driveway. Two officers lead Nandini out in handcuffs.
This isn't over, Maya. You have no idea who pulled you out of that fire.
Maya freezes. Nandini is pushed into the car.
What did she mean? Who saved me?
Savitri wheels forward. She looks at Maya, then at the gates, guilt written across her face.
There is one more secret in this family, child. And it is mine.
A motorbike stops at the gates. A rider in a black helmet watches them.
The rider lifts the visor. It is a woman, older, with Maya's eyes. Meera. Alive.

top_promos.title: Secret teased — Maya

lines.text: If my mother was murdered, I want the person who did it to lose everything.
Then we do it together. No more secrets.
They stand close. He brushes rain from her cheek. Neither moves away.
The rooftop door bangs open. Two of Nandini's security men step out.
Mr. Malhotra. Madam Nandini wants you downstairs. Now.
Tell her I'll come in the morning.
The guard steps aside. Behind him, Nandini herself walks onto the roof, smiling.
Meera stood exactly where you're standing, Maya. The night before the fire. Shall I tell you what she said?

top_promos.title: Return from the dead — Savitri

lines.text: Watch your tongue, Nandini. This girl is Meera's daughter. My granddaughter.
Silence. A glass slips from Nandini's fingers.
That's absurd. Meera's baby died with her. Everyone knows that.
Then someone should have told me. I've been alive this whole time.

top_promos.title: Dramatic confrontation — Maya

lines.text: My mother wrote that she was afraid of Nandini. Why would she write that, Vikram?
Vikram pulls off his glove. His hand is scarred from palm to wrist.
I burned this trying to break that bolt. The door was chained from outside. I couldn't get to you.
Then who pulled me out? I woke up in a hospital with no name.
